note: Kentucky State Parks campground in the narrow, wooded Whittleton Branch hollow at Natural Bridge near Slade. The electric and water back-in sites (24-37) run single file along the creek; electric-only pull-through sites 1-3 by the registration booth are not sold online, and the rest are tent sites. The Whittleton Arch and Henson's Arch trails start in the campground; Middle Fork campground, the lodge, pool and Natural Bridge trails are nearby. --Claude
summary: Kept. Whittleton loop alone: 40 sites (17 electric, 23 tent), 20/30A (stored 50A wrong), water at 24-37, lengths 35-40 ft back-in, pull-throughs 1-3 not sold online. Fees 30 / 35 / 39 holiday (stored 30-35). Season 2027 Mar 15 - Nov 15. Creekside CONFIRMED at 24-37 (agency site photos + 3DEP: channel 1.5-2 m below the floor, 20-28 m from the road).
flags: WATERFRONT CONFIRMED creekside (stored). Whittleton Branch is a small stream (3DEP channel only a few metres wide, well under 30 m) under canopy, so imagery cannot show it; the call rests on the agency's own RA site photos (camera-dated 2008-04-02) showing a brushy creek bank directly behind the gravel/asphalt pads of A024 and A029 with open leafless ground between, and on 3DEP cross-sections: along the electric/water row (37.7811,-83.6737 to 37.7826,-83.6732) the flat hollow floor sits 1.5-2 m above the channel, which runs 20-28 m east of the road centreline, i.e. a short easy walk down from the back of the pads. Named sites A024-A037 (Standard Electric, back-in, sold by the night on RA). RA tags every site 'Near Water - no' (a loose field). Suggested evidence: 'RA site photos A024/A029 (2008) creek bank behind pads; 3DEP 2026-11-24: Whittleton Branch channel 1.5-2 m below the hollow floor, 20-28 m from the A024-A037 road; canopy hides the stream on imagery'. Measured for Whittleton only; Middle Fork (1546) (pin 37.7687,-83.6755) is a separate campground ~1.4 km south and was not assessed.
HOOKUPS: stored electric 50 (derived from the note's '30/50A') is wrong; every electric site lists 'Multiple Electric Details: 20-30'. Written 30.
PIN: stored 37.7797,-83.6757 is on the park road at the KY 11 junction, ~270 m SW of the middle of the campground. Suggested 37.7813,-83.6736 (registration / mid electric row).
SITE LENGTH: the old note's 'tight loop best for rigs under ~30 ft' is contradicted by RA lengths of 35-40 ft back-in on A024-A037 (A024 35 ft); a 23-ft rig fits. Dropped from the note.
SEASON: RA closed through 2027-03-14; 2027 season Mar 15 - Nov 15. Stored season absent. Not on the parks.ky.gov improvements/closures list.
